items.title: NVIDIA open-sourced a shared meaning layer so AI agents stop misreading data
items.why: Grounds text-to-SQL agents in certified definitions and query lineage, so two agents stop disagreeing on "revenue."

items.title: A Rust CLI drives your browser through its accessibility tree, not pixels
items.why: Agents click named buttons instead of guessing screenshot coordinates — cheaper, steadier, and a fun systems project.

items.title: To debug a misbehaving AI agent, just ask it why it did that
items.why: Replay the exact prompt in isolation, ask the model to explain its choice, then reword the rule it misread.

items.title: He put a Claude agent on a $15 Pi Zero that can't choose its own code
items.why: It can trigger a git-pull update but never pick what gets deployed — a neat guardrail for self-modifying agents.

items.title: A 20-minute bike ride or a nap undid most of a sleepless night's memory loss
items.why: McGill, n=54: both routes lifted recognition memory ~22% after 30 hours awake, via different brain pathways.

items.title: nsenter drops you into a container's network namespace with the host's tools
items.why: Skips installing ip/tcpdump inside minimal images — one command borrows the host's toolkit instead.

items.title: A desktop panel finally makes debugging Postgres LISTEN/NOTIFY pleasant
items.why: Keeps a durable SQLite log of events with backoff reconnects, so a dropped connection stops losing notifications.

items.title: A deque keeps a DP table fast when each state only needs the best of the last k
items.why: Turns an O(nk) sliding-window DP into O(n) — reach for it when a CF problem smells like a window max.

items.title: Four minutes of daily bodyweight exercise measurably built strength
items.why: 97-person RCT, 12 weeks: short daily reps beat doing nothing — a floor worth hitting on exam-crunch days.

items.title: An open ASR model now understands 65 Indian languages, Garo and Gondi included
items.why: IISc/ARTPARK trained it on 31,000+ hours of speech in three stages — best on 10 of 17 benchmarked languages.
